versions.content: Purpose of the DiagnosticJ1939SwMapping The purpose of the DiagnosticJ1939SwMapping is to associate a SwComponentPrototype with a DiagnosticJ1939Node . By this means a concrete functionality is mapped to the abstract J1939 Controller Application .
